(def marriage-phase-inputs-verified "inputs_verified")
(def marriage-phase-chassis-lowered "chassis_lowered")
(def marriage-phase-cab-dropped "cab_dropped")
(def marriage-phase-powertrain-mounted "powertrain_mounted")
(def marriage-phase-harness-connected "harness_connected")
(def marriage-phase-attestation-emitted "attestation_emitted")

(defn get-marriage-state [state]
  (get state "marriage_state" {}))

(defn transition-to-inputs-verified [state]
  (let [s (get-marriage-state state)
        new-s (assoc s
                     :phase marriage-phase-inputs-verified
                     :completionPct 15
                     :inputs {:frameAttestationCid "bafkreiframeatt..."
                               :powertrainAttestationCid "bafkreiptatt..."
                               :cabBodyAttestationCid "bafkreicabatt..."})]
    {:marriage_state new-s
     :next_node "lower"}))

(defn transition-to-chassis-lowered [state]
  (let [s (get-marriage-state state)
        new-s (assoc s
                     :phase marriage-phase-chassis-lowered
                     :completionPct 35)]
    {:marriage_state new-s
     :next_node "cab"}))

(defn transition-to-cab-dropped [state]
  (let [s (get-marriage-state state)
        critical-torques [{:fastener "cab_mount_1" :torqueNm 320 :specNm 320 :tolerancePct 5}
                           {:fastener "cab_mount_2" :torqueNm 315 :specNm 320 :tolerancePct 5}
                           {:fastener "cab_mount_3" :torqueNm 322 :specNm 320 :tolerancePct 5}
                           {:fastener "cab_mount_4" :torqueNm 318 :specNm 320 :tolerancePct 5}]
        new-s (assoc s
                     :phase marriage-phase-cab-dropped
                     :completionPct 55
                     :criticalTorques critical-torques)]
    {:marriage_state new-s
     :next_node "powertrain"}))

(defn transition-to-powertrain-mounted [state]
  (let [s (get-marriage-state state)
        extra [{:fastener "engine_mount_left" :torqueNm 450 :specNm 450 :tolerancePct 5}
               {:fastener "engine_mount_right" :torqueNm 448 :specNm 450 :tolerancePct 5}
               {:fastener "transmission_mount" :torqueNm 280 :specNm 280 :tolerancePct 5}]
        new-s (assoc s
                     :phase marriage-phase-powertrain-mounted
                     :completionPct 75
                     :criticalTorques (concat (:criticalTorques s) extra))]
    {:marriage_state new-s
     :next_node "harness"}))

(defn transition-to-harness-connected [state]
  (let [s (get-marriage-state state)
        new-s (assoc s
                     :phase marriage-phase-harness-connected
                     :completionPct 90)]
    {:marriage_state new-s
     :next_node "attestation"}))

(defn transition-to-attestation-emitted [state]
  (let [s (get-marriage-state state)
        robot-signatures [{:robotDid "did:web:etzhayyim.com:otete-heavy-unit-1" :role "marriage_lead"
                           :timestamp "2026-05-26T13:00:00Z" :signature "..."}
                          {:robotDid "did:web:etzhayyim.com:mimi-precision-unit-1" :role "alignment_witness"
                           :timestamp "2026-05-26T13:00:05Z" :signature "..."}]
        new-s (assoc s
                     :phase marriage-phase-attestation-emitted
                     :completionPct 100
                     :robotSignatures robot-signatures)

                :chassisId (:chassisId s)
                :inputs (:inputs s)
                :criticalTorques (:criticalTorques s)
                :attestingRobots (:robotSignatures s)
                :recordedAt "2026-05-26T13:00:10Z"}]
    {:marriage_state new-s
     :marriage_attestation record
     :next_node "end"}))

def resolve_api_key() -> str:
    """KOTOBA_INFERENCE_API_KEY from env, else the macOS Keychain mirror.

    The key authorizes the loopback LiteLLM gateway (bearer). Never a commercial
    vendor key (those would be refused by assert_murakumo_only anyway).
    """
    env = os.environ.get("KOTOBA_INFERENCE_API_KEY") or os.environ.get("MURAKUMO_API_KEY")
    if env:
        return env
    try:
        out = subprocess.run(
            ["security", "find-generic-password", "-s", "etzhayyim",
             "-a", "KOTOBA_INFERENCE_API_KEY", "-w"],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10,
        )
        if out.returncode == 0 and out.stdout.strip():
            return out.stdout.strip()
    except Exception:
        pass
    # LiteLLM often accepts any bearer for loopback; fall back to a placeholder so
    # a misconfigured key surfaces as an auth error, not a silent commercial call.
    return "sk-murakumo-loopback"
